dms is the DankMaterialShell management CLI and backend server.

Usage:
  dms [flags]

Available Commands:
  auth                  Manage DMS authentication sync
  backup                Backup and restore DMS configuration
  blur                  Background blur utilities
  brightness            Control device brightness
  chroma                Syntax highlight source code
  clipboard             Manage clipboard
  color                 Color utilities
  completion            Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  config                Configuration utilities
  dank16                Generate Base16 color palettes
  debug-srv             Start the debug server
  dl                    Download a URL to stdout or file
  doctor                Diagnose DMS installation and dependencies
  dpms                  Control display power management
  greeter               Deprecated: moved to the standalone dms-greeter binary
  help                  Help about any command
  ipc                   Send IPC commands to running DMS shell
  keybinds              Manage keybinds and cheatsheets
  kill                  Kill running dms processes
  matugen               Generate Material Design themes
  notify                Send a desktop notification
  open                  Open a file, URL, or resource with an application picker
  plugins               Manage DMS plugins
  qr                    Generate QR codes
  randr                 Query output display information
  registry              Manage plugin and theme registries
  restart               Restart the running dms instance
  run                   Launch dms (backend + UI)
  screenshot            Capture screenshots
  setup                 Deploy DMS configurations
  switch-user           Switch to another active session on this seat
  system                System operations
  trash                 Manage the user's trash (XDG Trash spec 1.0)
  update                Update DankMaterialShell to the latest version
  version               Show version information

Flags:
  -c, --config string   Path to a UI config dir (containing shell.qml) to use instead of the embedded UI (env: DMS_SHELL_DIR)
  -h, --help            help for dms

Use "dms [command] --help" for more information about a command.
